description: The careful policy for a whole run of 100 shifts (docs/plans/progression-phases.md): it buys an iron drill and a steel drill at the market, smelts and makes a pickaxe and lanterns, brings two camps to level 4, buys a camp kit and places a deep camp, plants saplings, keeps a pen and makes hay, delivers 31 contracts of tiers 1 and 2, sells its surplus, and the run ends finished, scored in coins
